avis.texte: I usually don't use oil balms because of many unhappy experiences but I needed one that was gentle and fragrance free to remove my balm foundation. I was pleasantly surprised at how easy it was to emulsify and rinse off easily. Make sure to make balm into liquid and rinse face a few times. I follow with my Cerave hydrating cleanser for a 2nd cleanse. I have dry, sensitive, and mature skin for reference. Only down side is the size of the jar.

avis.titre: Caused a rash by my eyes!!
avis.texte: I have sensitive eye areas when it comes to a makeup removing balm, and I was desperate to have something that removes my waterproof makeup. This doesnt really remove all the makeup and it caused a rash by my eyes. Wouldn't use again.

This balm does not remove my makeup at all, i used it on a full face and even after rubbing for a while and emulsifying and double cleansing there is still makeup residue…how can this be? This product also leaves a film on top of the skin. Not great. Its too oily and the first reason as to why it sucks is because it does not even remove make up well…

I've used survey products for years and have loved everything I have used until this product. I have extremely sensitive skin and up until this product, I have had very good results. However, this was not the case for this particular product. My skin hasn't been this broken out in years. If you have sensitive skin, I would steer clear.
I tried this as a cheaper alternative to Farmacy. It didn't measure up. It's hard to wash off completely; leaves a film.
This is my first time using this product and I love it. It is a great cleansing balm that doesn't leave your skin feeling so dry.

Love this product to travel with. Can dispense into travel size containers. DO NOT use to remove eye makeup! Rub a small amount between fingers to melt and dab on entire face before lightly massaging into skin. I use a warm wash cloth to remove. Love not having to buy WATER in a large cleansing cream bottle or face wash!
Product works but smells bad imo it kind of smells like tequilla
I thought it was a larger amount of product. Will be sticking with the clinique balm.
This removes my waterproof eyeliner and mascara easily and wipes clean, no greasy residue.

Im not a fan of this…. I have multiple face washes from them but this really isn't it. I feel like this doesnt really melt my makeup off rather this just leaves a residue. I do double cleanse but even when i double cleanse i have to go in with makeup remover. My skin is dried out after (even before the extra steps).

I have very sensitive, acne prone skin. I have to be incredibly careful when implementing a new product. I tried this as an alternative to washing my face at night, which may sound crazy, but doing this has completely restored my skincare routine and I now have a nice, dewy low. I always make sure to rinse after using it, of course. I will say it's not very effective at taking off mascara, though.

I will only ever buy this cleansing balm. Super effective at cleansing makeup, I've tried other balms that irritate my sensitive, acne-prone skin. This balm doesn't irritate my skin and I have repurchased it several times. The only issue with this product is the small size. I wish they made a jumbo version so I didn't have to repurchase as often.
This cleanser works on all makeup, even mascara with good staying power. Also soft on my skin. Totally worth it. Will buy again

avis.titre: I can't get past the smell
avis.texte: This works pretty good for removing my makeup, even waterproof mascara, but the smell is so much. That I dread using it. The smell alone is enough for me to keep looking for a different make up removing balm.
I don't like this product. Melts easily but leaves a cast that is so difficult to wash off. Would not repurchase.
It is more waxy than a typical cleansing balm would be. It gets off surface level impurities but it does nothing for my sebaceous filaments. You can find better for a better price as well.
I bought this as an alternative to my regular cleaning oil, but this does NOT remove all the makeup and leaves an oil film on the skin. had to use my cleanser twice to remove.

I've been using this cleansing balm for years because it's so effective and gentle. I use lash glue on my eyebrows every day and this takes it right off, no problem. It also melts away eyeliner and mascara (even waterproof!) without having to scrub at all.
I think I like Farmacy better- but haven't been using long enough to give my full impression.

I absolutely lovf this product. Its an absolute steal from other cleansing balms and very easily melts off makeup. I will notbpurchsse agsin as this product has been clogging my sink. The savings from other cleansing balms not worth a plumbing bill.
this product smells like chemicals so bad, I can't stand it. I am 1/8th of a way through it and will be throwing it out.

I truly thought that It would be somehow something else, but I felt that I simply could buy a Coconut Oil and it would do the exact same job for a better price. I´m not saying that the product it´s bad, because it´s not, but that´s the best way to describe how it works and it´s texture! I think I can recommend but just keep in mind that is easily a dupe from coconut oil.

This does not feel clean or wash off easily aka emulsify probably because of the castor oil. It leaves my skin feeling waxy or with a layer of film over it so I make sure to use a foaming face wash after it always then its fine. But im just trying to use up what i bought, would not recommend.
Love this for camping or no-water situations. Takes the makup off like a champ and my normal to dry skin feels great!

avis.titre: Great Cleansing Balm- First Step In Double Cleanse
avis.texte: This Cerave Balm is very gentle on my face. This is my first step in my night-time double cleanse. Wonderful and I have oily skin and does not make my face oily after use.

Not sure what fragrance everyone is talking about. I smell nothing. It works well for me but I do typically follow up with my face wash afterwards so that's likely part of why I think so. Quick, effective and super gentle. Doesn't break me out or over dry me either.
Greasy mess. Smells like chemicals. Hard to remove. Went straight in the trash can.
I have bought the Cerave makeup removing cleansing balm multiple times. For the price and quality, it's worth repurchasing. Of course, follow up with another cleanser!

I love this cleanser, it does the job and does not sting my eyes, it is hard to remove once you emulsify it though. What I didn't realize its how expensive it is, I thought I was getting the cheapest option bc its 13 bucks but its too small literally 1 oz.

avis.titre: Not bad but there is better
avis.texte: Its not a bad product but however there are better products out there and cheaper even. It does have a smell like a plastic smell, doesnt bother me though. I didnt read the amount well and didn't realize how small it is. I wouldn't have boughten it if i knew how small the container was. Save your money and get a different one.
It removes my makeup well but I cant get past the smell. They claims this to be fragrance free but it has a smell. Kinda smells like essential oils or chemicals. I prefer my true fragrance free ones.

avis.titre: I really wanted to love this
avis.texte: I'm trying to find an affordable cleansing balm, had super high hopes for this one. My first note, yes you're paying a more drugstore price but holy moly is this jar small. Does the cleansing balm work? Yes, have I tried cleansing balms that work a bit better and doesn't require using as much? Yes. My main gripe though is that I'm not someone with super sensitive eyes whatsoever and there is something in here that BURNS the ever loving life out of my eyes. I was so shocked because it's CeraVe and it's supposed to be gentle but my god, this stuff burned my eyes like no tomorrow. I can't recommend at all, CeraVe does have great products but for me anyways this is far from one of them.

I have sensitive skin especially towards bacteria , when i put this on to remove my makeup it removess!!!! And when i leave the balm on ( i know youre not supposed to ) it litterally removes my dark marks dark fades , acne. My skin be looking so smooth and clear. 10/10 dont change the formula CERAVE

avis.titre: Makeup removing but don't get it anywhere near your eyes!
avis.texte: I honestly feel stupid for buying this product because I previously bought the cream-to-foam version of this cleanser and absolutely hated it. I should have assumed this would be the same. It advertises makeup removing, even uses an icon of a mascara wand, but the directions say "do not come in contact with eyes" and boy are they right, because it stings like crazy. I have to use eye drops after because my eyes are burning. Also no matter how hard you try to avoid your mouth it will seep in and taste like crap.
This does not emulsify, it is very difficult to remove, and it did not remove my waterproof makeup (mascara). I broke out terribly because the product does not fully rinse off. Returned it.

I was skeptical about using this because I usually dont do well with balms and prefer cleansing oils. However this stuff blew me away! It easily melts my makeup and lifts it off of my skin. The only things I dont like is thete is too little product and that it doesn't emulsify, but I just wash with my Cerave Hydrating to Foam cleanser and use Thayers unscented Witch Hazel after and it completely removes everything while keeping my skin soft and plump. This is my new holy grail routine!

This works for taking off my makeup very well. I like that there are no fragrances but because of that it does smell like the oil that is in the product. To me it washes off well. I also am a fan because if the price.

avis.titre: It works but it smells so bad
avis.texte: I cant get over the chemical smell. I will be returning this product
it gets the job done, but it does leave a sticky thick residue after and doesnt seem like going away with water

avis.titre: Removes makeup (sort of) but caused me to break out
avis.texte: Bought this cleansing balm because I generally trust CeraVe skin products - I use their AM and PM moisturizers regularly with almost no problems. I bought this cleansing balm in March 2024, and I noticed that since around that time, I've been having regular breakouts on my cheeks and jawline. (Disclaimer: I have PCOS so I'm already acne-prone, but for about a year before that my acne was well under control.) Given the timing and the fact that I'd changed nothing in my diet or skincare routine, I highly suspect this cleansing balm is the culprit. It does remove makeup for the most part, but I found that I still had to wipe it off even after rinsing with water before going in with my normal cleanser. I wouldn't buy this product again.
This cleansing balm worked well but OMG the smell was so bad and it lingered even after i washed my face. It smellls like chemicals and latex and it is STRONG. I definitely will return immediately

I am truly impressed by not only how well this performed but how long it lasted. The container may be small, but you don't need to use up much product at once for it to be effective. It doesn't irritate my skin nor does it make me breakout, and it makes removing makeup a much easier process. I also like to use this to double cleanse even when I have no makeup on, to give myself that really clean feeling. This is a win for anyone with sensitive and/or are acne prone skin, especially since it's fragrance-free! **P.S. It's rare for me to rate something 5 stars, but this truly deserves it! I have no complaints whatsoever and will keep this as a go-to always.

avis.titre: Recommend for the sensitive skin people!
avis.texte: It is super gentle on my skin and I don't feel a burning sensation after like I have with some other balms I've tried! I do have to give a little extra love for it to remove my mascara though. Overall, would highly recommend for the sensitive skin people!

I've used a few different makeup removing balms and this is definitely my favorite. You need such a small amount of the product that it seems to last forever. It's unscented which is a must for me when it comes to skincare and it has completely eliminated makeup removing wipes from my product list!

This is a great value, and I think it might be a new favorite balm of mine. There is no favorite. This is easy to use, didn't cause any breakouts, and made my skin feel clean. If I was wearing make up or just sunscreen, this was always nice to use at the end of the day

I love this product! I use this every night. It takes only a small amount and it easily and gently removes my makeup. Even waterproof mascara. Sometimes I use it alone and sometimes I cleanse with the Cerave foaming wash after.

avis.titre: amazing at getting off stubborn makeup
avis.texte: best cleaning balm to remove foundation and mascara. the product lasts forever as only a small amount will remove makeup from the entire face and eyes.

I found this to be great at getting makeup off, just make sure you wash it off all the way. The cleanser itself is so smooth and creamy, it feels nice to put it on your skin. Would recommend for those who wear makeup often!

avis.titre: One of the most worked make up remover !
avis.texte: How do people sleep on this ? This typically one of the most effective make up remover balm that i ever used ! It's affordable and working so well on my face. As i usually make up twice a week i find it's hard to only remove it with micellar water. I search for the balm , this got my attention. Use it with warm water. Worked so well. All cleaned up after a few massages. Then i used the cerave make up remover wet paper and then foam cleanser that last. That my triple cleans for my face. To remove all the make up and dirts and oil ( or balm left) after a day. It's gentle and doesn't causing me any trouble skin. Later on i can go on with my skincare routine!
This product feels like wax on your face. Its hard to get off and you definitely need to scrub hard after taking this off with another cleanser. I would not recommend.

I love this product!! It's my go to make up remover. I can't live without this in my skin care routine. The balm is so soft one the skin and you feel clean and hydrated right after. The size is perfect for travel and lasts a long time!

I like the texture of this cleansing balm and my skin was soft after using it and following with the CeraVe toner, but the smell of the product is off-putting. The pot I purchased has quite a chemical smell. :(
Bought this for traveling and it works great. I have dry, sensitive skin and had no issues. Only con is the smell, but I'd still recommend it.

I am loving this product. I have used high end brands of makeup melting balm and this one is just as effective. It melts off my makeup instantly and cleanses my face perfectly. It is fragrance free and doesn't break me out.

If you don't double cleanse after using make up, today is the day to start! This make up cleanser balm is so hydrating and smooth and literally melts the make up off your face. This product plus the hydrating cream facial wash will leave your skin hydrated and moisturized! It's so great for sensitive skin with no smells of perfume or harsh chemicals.

I switched to this when my skin was going through a dry/rough spell because I thought it'd be gentler and this is my favorite remover. It cuts through makeup and leaves my skin feeling supple and hydrated.

The CeraVe Makeup Removing Cleanser Balm is a game-changer for anyone looking for an effective and gentle way to remove makeup. Its rich, creamy texture melts away even stubborn, long-wearing products without stripping the skin of its natural moisture. I love how easily it emulsifies with water, rinsing away cleanly without leaving any residue behind. Plus, its non-comedogenic formula means it won't clog pores or cause breakouts, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone skin. While it effectively removes makeup, I've found that it may require a bit of extra effort for heavy eye makeup or waterproof products. Overall, it's a fantastic option for daily makeup removal that leaves skin feeling clean, soft, and hydrated.

avis.titre: Great product for sensitive skin and removing makeup with...
avis.texte: As you can see from the second picture, I have some pretty severe facial eczema. I have been using this product for about a month to take my mascara off and it has a buttery melting effect when applied and leaves my skin feeling very hydrated. It takes my makeup off without damaging my skin or my lashes. It smells pleasant but not overly fragrant. I cannot tolerate overly fragrant products on my skin because it will cause my skin to have a really bad flare up from my skin condition. I would highly recommend to anyone with sensitive skin in need of a good makeup remover.
This smells awful! It works fine, and rinses off well, but the smell is just too much for me.

Stubborn Makeup? With CeraVe makeup Removing Balm will certainly do the trick! On DRY face get a dime size and rub onto DRY face in circular motion and you shortly see your makeup MELTING off your face! Wash Throughly with water! after using this product use hydrating cream to foam cleanser to wash off after using cleanser balm.￼ it has three essential ceramides.
Love this cleansing balm-perfect consistency, and takes off all the makeup!!
I love the consistency of how it feels on my face but the smell is terrible and can be a big turn off for people.
horrible. doesn't take makeup off. don't waste your money. Tru E.L.F way better

This is very similar to the inky list makeup remover, however it feels less oily on the skin. The bottle is extremely small tho and they don't have a bigger one.

avis.titre: That this Servi make up removing Cleansing balm melts you...

This cleansing balm was generally effective in removing my makeup while not irritating my skin, but I noticed that it took some effort to remove my non-waterproof mascara. avis.titre: My fav budget friendly makeup remover
avis.texte: If you're looking for a dupe for the Clinique makeup removing balm, this is it. Definitely does it's job and I love Cereve as a skincare line for problem skin so it's sensitive skin friendly as well.

I should have read the ingredients more carefully. I love cereve products so I didn't do my do dilligance and now I have red skin and itritsted skin by my eyes. I used it to remove my fill face of makeup and when I finished it went straight in the trash.

avis.titre: It removed makeup but smell is HORRIBLE
avis.texte: I gave 2 stars because it did remove my makeup, but i cant use it a second time because the smell was so pungent. It did not have a fragrance smell, but more of a chemical or fake smell.
I wanted to like it..It removed the makeup fine but it broke me out probably due to the fact that it has some pore clogging ingredients I didnt notice when buying. I'll stick to my elf cleansing balm
Super easy to take your makeup off and way better for you than makeup wipes . Easy use. I've been using their products for years and lap far everything's been good .

Best I've ever used. I read the one star reviews and based on what they said, it is definitely user error. They are simply not using the product correctly. This melts my makeup and sunscreen completely off. When I wash the balm off with my regular Cerave cleanser, there is no greasy afterwards. Cerave please consider making a jumbo size. I do go through these quickly because I use it on my face all the way down my neck to get the sunscreen off. I WILL PAY MORE FOR A BIGGER SIZE!!!

This is an excellent makeup removal balm. I have tried many others, and this one will actually remove all of my makeup, even the waterproof mascsra! Dont use this expecting it to take everything thing off in 2 seconds. You need to work the balm into your skin to help breakdown the makeup. Not only does it do a great job removing the makeup but it also leaves my skin feeling soft. I have tried so many other that leave my skin so dry afterwards! This is definitely a holy grail product for me!
Smells like burning plastic. Made my entire face red and had a burning sensation for hours. Horrible product. I wish I could get my money back!! Not a happy customer

I bought this bc i heard about "double cleansing" and i wanted to try it. This product for me was super greasy and didn't remove anything, all it did was smudge my makeup around on my face until my actual cleanser got it off. I will add that I don't wear that much make up, just a little eyeliner and mascara, but I couldn't even get that off. Maybe it works for some people, everyone's skin is different, but for me this is a solid 0

avis.titre: Unfortunately did not work for me
avis.texte: I started to breakout on my cheek and forehead where I never breakout about a week after using it so I have to discontinue. Also I did have to use micellar water after to take off the rest of my makeup so it didn't completely remove it.

It works well eventually. It's a stiff blob to remove from the jar and then it softens unevenly. If you try just pressing it between your fingers to soften before spreading it on your face, little stiff bits can stick to your face or sides of fingers or even fall in the sink etc. At the end of a long day, having to deal with this bugs me! I suggest melting the blob in your palm, squishing the stiffer bits and really making sure all is melted before applying it to your face. So I just keep this for traveling since it certainly won't leak anywhere. I don't plan to buy it again.

I bought this product because I was running out of my regular cleansing balm and this was the only one available to me. I trust the CeraVe brand and have used their hydrating cleanser, daily lotion, and cream for years on my sensitive skin so I had high expectations. This is actually probably the worst cleansing balm I've tried and I'm surpsied that CeraVe has even put this on the market. First, I much prefer other balms with little scoops in the packaging to help keep your product clean - this one does not have that. Second, after you scoop this out with your finger (gross) and start rubbing it in your hands, not all of the product melts. When applying it on the skin, it has such a pungent chemical smell which makes the whole washing your face thing for self care reasons a very unpleasant task. It's almost unbearable and very unlike a typical CeraVe product which is why I'm so surprised. Lastly, you go through this whole ordeal of putting this stuff on your face all for it to not work at all and leave a waxy, slimy residue on your skin - along with makeup that it didn't even take off - that you will need to scrub off with a washcloth at the end before continuing with your routine. I brought this with me on a weekend trip and tried it multiple times and I could not get this balm to work for me. It's sadly awful, and I would highly recommend using any other brand for a cleansing balm because you'll honestly a ton more product for your money and it will actually take your makeu
this product has been a go to for a couple months now. It really does help melt away make up (even waterproof mascara) and lash glue. like seriously the lash glue just melts off your lashes.

bought this product to try since i was using elf cleansing balm and wasnt sure if there was a better cleansing balm out there. caused breakout on my chin like ive never had before and my cheeks. save your money.
I will buy this again so gentle and takes all makeup off and makes your skin feel really soft! Excellent buy!

avis.titre: removes makeup well but causes break outs

I actually first used it to clean off some patch testing I did on my arm, and it cleaned through eyeshadow, eyeliner, lipstick, the whole nine yards. I was impressed.

Ive tried hundreds of cleansers and every one really messes up my skin barrier, or doesn't cleanse well enough. I found an oil based one from a Canadian company called The Other Skin Care Co. ive used it for over a year and love it. Unfortunately Its very expensive. I tried this cerave one in combination with the Other Skincare Co. cleansing water/toner, and my skin is so happy.

avis.titre: When used around eyes, water not a good idea
avis.texte: I bought CeraVe makeup removing cleanser balm mainly to remove mascara. I do like the nice, creamy feel of the balm and it does melt away mascara. However, I was surprised that the directions say to rinse with water and pat dry! Rinsing with water tends to get the balm into my eyes and it says avoid contact with eyes. I think using a tissue or facial cleansing pad (dry) would be safer.
This product makes my makeup removal so easy and effortless. I love how clean my skin feels. It takes very little product to be effective.
Not really sure why a makeup removing product has to be avoided around eyes. But I have had nonstop eye irritation from this product.

regardless of how much makeup or how little you wear this balm will take.it. off! even on days were its just mostrizing and sunscreen I use it to fully clean my skin! no fragrance, no dies nothing to cause irritation!

This product is good in theory, maybe good in practice for some, but my skin is sensitive and seemed to liked the farmacy one way better. This broke me out, was difficult to get out of my eyes (i know most can leave a film, but this last too long), and just didn't do as good a job at not leaving a film on my face. I always double cleanse, but for example, the farmacy one felt soft and like it was actually doing something whereas this one was relying solely on removing makeup rather than being a "good for your face too" product. It also doesn't smell good, and if you're sensitive to smell i do not recommend this. Again, if you're not sensitive skin or sense of smell wise then sure this product can definitely work and be the one for you!
I purchased this hoping it was an inexpensive version of Banila Co. Clean it Zero. Not even close. Will go back to Banila Co.
This is a great product, removes all makeup, and leaves skin feeling nourished.

This is the first cleansing balm ive ever used, and its great! It melts really quickly and gets my makeup off after one go! It leaves the skin feeling fresh and clean. I love it so much, I sometimes use it as a regular cleanser!

avis.titre: Good for price but won't buy again

avis.titre: Love most cerave items but NOT this.
avis.texte: My skin felt both greasy not clean and dry at the same time after use….I inadvertently got some on my lower eyelid 0 I think…..and wound up twice with an eye infection.

avis.titre: Very happy with the CeraVe makeup remover
avis.texte: I bought this product to take off my makeup and that's exactly what it does in a gentle way. I've previously used makeup removing wipes which irritated my skin, and other removers were okay but nothing like this. I personally love this product.

This is the best makeup remover I have ever tried! It easily melts the makeup off my face and feels super hydrating. I love how it's oily-skin friendly, and this is definitely something I'll repurchase.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it because it's Cerave
avis.texte: The formula is very greasy and takes forever to wash off. Doesnt do a great job with my waterproof mascara. Having to stick my fingers in the pot to scoop the product out was pretty inefficient.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again

I am a big fan of cerave but I do not like this. I can't place the smell but it's familiar but not in a good way. Its oily and feels impossible to get off even after cleansing. This product melts your makeup off so easily while keeping your face moisturized!

I really like this cleansing balm! I use it before i double cleanse at night to remove my waterproof eye makeup. It hasnt dried me out, caused any issues. The only thing I dont like about it is the smell. It's a very strong smell - almost smells like car fumes

I will definitely buy more when I run out and would definitely recommend this.

This is the fourth time purchasing this! I love it so much. I have senstive skin and this doesn't irritate me. I use the make up eraser with it - best combo!

I had been using a more expensive brand that I absolutely like . But I wanted to find something more in my price range. I was introduced to this brand which is great because I use this facial cleanser. I'm like oh it a lot!
This product worked wonders on my sensitive skin. Many of the negative comments on here are from people not using the product right. When used properly it's great!!

avis.titre: Finally a product that removes my make up!
avis.texte: I stumbled upon this balm accidently as I was looking at the other Cerave products; read the label and thought I would give it a try. I could not be more pleased with it. All mascara, eye liner, brow wax/product POOF gone. It is very clean feeling and washes off with fash wash nicely.
I thought this was terrible. Smelled like chemicals so much that I had to throw it away. Much thicker than other balms.

I have used the product for a few months now and my acne has been super under control. I recently used micellar water to remove my makeup since that was the only thing available, and I have little breakouts now. This is not harsh on your skin and doesnt leave you feeling oily or anything. I love this product so much!

This is not as life changing as I had hoped. This does a great job of removing makeup, but you will still need to thoroughly cleanse your face afterwards. The first couple of times I used this I did not cleanse afterwards and it caused me to breakout. This will definitely clog your pores.
I haven't broken out after wearing makeup for a whole day. Usually when I wash my face I break out but this product has allowed my skin to look the same the next day.
Nothing special about this cleansing balm. It is just average. I have used better cleansing balms. won't repurchase.
This is a must have if you like to double cleanse with a balm. I have bought a Korean brand for years. This is definitely is a stronger contender for it. I hope they decide to make a bigger size!
